text: The quantum key distribution protocol using four polarization states drawn from two conjugate bases was proposed in 1984 by Charles Bennett and Gilles ___.
explanation: BB84 is named for Bennett and Brassard, who introduced it in Bangalore in 1984. Ekert, by contrast, independently proposed the entanglement-based E91 protocol in 1991, deriving security from a Bell/CHSH violation rather than from conjugate-basis encoding.
